title: Flags are fake CSS colour stripes
what: Every flag is drawn as equal vertical stripes from a colour list. The UK (Glencoe) and Australia (Corryong) render as the French tricolour, Slovenia as a Russian-style tricolour, India as Ireland, Colombia/Brazil/South Africa as random bars, North Macedonia as Spain.
why: A careful designer never ships wrong national flags; it is the single most obvious 'generated' tell. SailGP uses real, correctly proportioned flag artwork (Canada maple leaf, Union Jack, Swiss cross) at the top of every column.
fix: Replace the stripe arrays with real flag SVGs (e.g. flag-icons via cdn.jsdelivr.net or inline SVG per country), 3:2 ratio, square corners, no glow ring. Use the same asset in strip, rows, SRS list, drawer.

title: Country name as headline, repeated; event name squeezed and truncated
what: Each row's biggest text is the country: COLOMBIA appears six times, AUSTRALIA four, BRAZIL/FRANCE/UK twice in a row. The actual event name sits beside it in small light italic and is cut with an ellipsis ('FM Punjab Cup Pakista…', 'Primera Válida Nacional Open Roldanillo 2…', 'SRS Nor…').
why: Repeating the same word down a list is a data-dump pattern, not editorial. SailGP's calendar headlines the venue city (HALIFAX, PORTSMOUTH, SASSNITZ) and lets the flag carry the country.
fix: Headline = venue/city (ROLDANILLO, BRIGHT, GLENCOE); country only as the flag + its name in the meta line; event name in full on its own line in upright regular weight, never truncated (wrap instead).

title: Route doodle + '81.8 km · 4 TP · PREVIEW' on every row
what: Every non-SRS row ends with a tiny generated polyline glyph and a made-up task distance labelled 'PREVIEW'. Tasks are not set until race morning, so the numbers are invented filler repeated 21 times.
why: A decorative sparkline on every row is a classic template filler; the data does not exist. SailGP rows/columns carry only real facts: event number, flag, city, dates.
fix: Remove the glyph and km column. Use the freed width for real data (category/class, entry count or registration status, 'Results' link for past rounds). Show a task only where a real one exists.

title: Fake podium with gold/teal/yellow gradient blocks for a race not yet flown
what: Opening the next round (Pakistan, starts tomorrow) shows '1st PLACE #80 59.7 KM' on orange, teal and olive gradient podium steps, then zebra-striped leaderboard rows, all from a random simulation that loops.
why: Gradient podium steps are a stock dashboard trope, and presenting invented standings for a future event is the strongest 'demo' signal on the page. SailGP shows standings only after racing, as a plain ruled table.
fix: Drop the podium and leaderboard from upcoming rounds. For upcoming: schedule (race days, times), venue, registration/pilot list link. For past rounds: a plain ruled results table (pos, pilot, nation flag, points) with hairlines, no gradients, no zebra.

title: Uppercase, letter-spaced micro-labels everywhere
what: About 20 different classes set 9.5–11 px bold uppercase with .12–.16em tracking: CONCEPT, STARTS IN, DAYS/HRS/MIN/SEC, NEXT SRS ROUND, ROUND DETAILS, FEATURED SERIES, eyebrows, chips, row run lines, month-rail '2026 · 2 ROUNDS', '4 TP · PREVIEW', 'IN 5 DAYS', status, spec labels, legend keys, KPI captions, '1ST PLACE'.
why: When every secondary line is the same tracked-out caps it becomes texture, the hallmark of generated UI. SailGP keeps small caps to the nav, buttons and one 'EVENT 07' label per column; dates and meta are big numerals or plain sentence case.
fix: Keep tracked caps only for nav, buttons and one label type (round number). Set meta lines (venue, days, relative dates, KPI captions, spec labels) in sentence-case 13–14 px regular. Delete the eyebrows above headings.

title: Gradient accent bar and gradient fills for SRS
what: SRS columns in the strip get a 4 px blue-purple-red gradient bar across the top (the same kind of accent bar the owner already had removed from list rows) plus a blue gradient tint. The 'SHOW SRS ROUNDS' button and the gantt SRS pills are filled with the same gradient.
why: Accent bars and multi-stop gradient fills are pure decoration. It also breaks the solid-orange button rule. SailGP marks its featured round by giving it a wider white panel, not by colour bars.
fix: Delete .col.srs::after and the gradient tint; mark SRS columns with the SRS mark only (already present). Make 'Show SRS rounds' a solid orange or outline button. Gantt SRS bars: solid single colour (SRS blue) or white.

title: Three stat rows saying the same thing, with count-up
what: '26 rounds' appears five times (stat band, tour stats, rounds header, filter chip, region dropdown). There are three separate big-italic-number rows: the 4 equal stat boxes under the hero (which count up from 0), SRS KPIs (5 / 4 / 39 / 112), and the tour stats (26 / 6 / 3,262 km / 299 days).
why: Equal stat boxes with animated count-ups are a landing-page template; repeating them three times shows nobody edited the page. SailGP's calendar page has no stat bands at all.
fix: Delete the stat band under the hero and the SRS KPI row. Keep at most one quiet line in the tour section ('26 rounds in 12 countries, Nov 2026 – Sep 2027'). No count-up animation.

title: Host banner: gradient-clipped text, glow blobs, diamond bullets
what: 'HOST YOUR COMPETITION' is heavy italic with a white-to-grey gradient clipped into the letters, second line orange; two large radial glows (teal top-left, orange bottom-right) sit behind; the bullet list uses rotated orange diamonds; photo is masked and tinted.
why: Gradient text, ambient glow blobs and custom diamond bullets are three generated-UI clichés in one block. SailGP's equivalent (SailGP+ sign-up) is flat: solid headline, plain paragraph, one red button.
fix: Solid white headline (upright or the one italic style), no gradient, remove .host::before/::after glows, plain list or a single sentence, keep the photo full-bleed on the right without mask fade.

title: Next round repeated three times above the fold
what: Race bar: 'PAKISTAN 25 Nov – 29 Nov 2026 · STARTS IN · countdown · ROUND DETAILS'. Hero card directly below: 'NEXT ROUND 25–29 NOV · PAKISTAN / FM Punjab Cup Pakistan 26 / ROUND DETAILS'. Nav also has a LIVE pill, and the race bar a 'NEXT SRS ROUND' pill.
why: Redundant blocks are a sign of components assembled without editing. SailGP shows the next event once, in the green race bar under the nav, then goes straight to the page title and calendar.
fix: Keep the race bar as the single next-round module. Hero becomes photo + title only (or remove the info card). Move the live-tracker link to the nav only.

title: Ten accent colours
what: Orange, light orange (#FF8A3D), yellow (#FFC906, TODAY line, take-off marker, podium), teal (#2BD4C4 chips, live, hike & fly), dark teal, a second red (#FF3B30 live dots), SRS blue, SRS red, purple (gradient), slate grey bars. The gantt alone uses five.
why: An uncontrolled palette reads as generated. SailGP uses dark green/near-black, white and one red; colour otherwise comes only from flags and photos.
fix: Limit to: teal-black, white, greys, orange. SRS blue only inside the SRS logo. Hike & fly = outline or white instead of teal; TODAY = white hairline; remove yellow and the second red.
where: src/season-calendar.html:14 :root accents; 438 srs colours; 443 #FF3B30; 1376 gantt colours; 1389-1391 TODAY; 1117 label colours

title: Cross-month date ranges read backwards
what: Rounds spanning two months show '27–03 JAN/FEB', '31–06 JAN/FEB', '23–02 FEB/MAR', '26–02 JUN/JUL': the range runs from a bigger number to a smaller one with a slashed month pair.
why: Looks like a bug. SailGP always stacks day + month for both ends ('20 JUN – 21 JUN').
fix: Show '27 Jan – 3 Feb' (day + month on each side) whenever months differ; keep '25–29 Nov' only for same-month ranges.

title: The calendar is buried below the SRS section and stat bands
what: On a page called 'World calendar', the calendar strip starts at y≈2,275 px at 1440 (≈3,000 px at 390): after race bar, hero, stat band and a 900 px SRS section. The rounds list starts at y≈5,000.
why: SailGP's /races/ page puts the strip directly under the 'SEASON CALENDAR' title. Burying the main content under promo blocks is template thinking.
fix: Order: race bar → short title → calendar strip → rounds list → tour map/timeline → SRS feature → host. Keep SRS prominent via its marked columns/rows and a full-width SRS block after the strip.

title: Phone header logo wraps; race bar is 220 px tall
what: At 390 px the wordmark breaks into 'airtri / bune', and the race bar stacks into four rows (country+dates, countdown, SRS pill, Round details) taking 220 px before the hero.
why: Broken wordmark is an obvious bug. SailGP's phone race bar is one compact line with the countdown.
fix: white-space:nowrap on the wordmark (and hide 'Create event' text or shrink it); on phone hide .rb-srs and .rb-go, put country + countdown on one line (~56 px).

title: Arrow-in-circle on every row plus 'IN N DAYS'
what: Each row ends in a 30 px outlined circle containing an arrow that fills orange on hover, next to tracked-caps 'IN 47 DAYS'.
why: Circle-arrow affordances on every row are a UI-kit default. The whole row is already clickable; SailGP rows/columns have no per-item arrow.
fix: Remove .go circles; show relative time only for the next 2–3 rounds, otherwise nothing (the date already says it). Row hover = background change only.

title: Dot- and slash-separated word runs
what: 'PARAGLIDING · SEASON 2026/27', 'CHAKRAL, PUNJAB / 5 DAYS / CUP' on every row, '26 ROUNDS / 12 COUNTRIES / 5 SRS' with orange slashes, '2026 · 2 ROUNDS', 'Replay SRS Tapalpa 2026 · Task 3 · 58.7 km', '10 rounds · Mar–Sep · close-up right', 'Asia · S. America · Africa · …'.
why: Chaining fragments with separators is how generators fake density. SailGP writes 'RACE DAY 1 | SATURDAY, 28 NOVEMBER' once, and otherwise uses layout (stacked lines, columns) not punctuation.
fix: Cut each run to the one fact that matters (venue on its own line; days only in drawer), or lay facts out in fixed columns. Remove the r-head run (filters already show counts).

title: Pulsing and blinking status dots
what: Red pulsing dot in nav LIVE pill, red dot in hero live-tracker card, teal dot in the 'NEXT ROUND' chip, orange dot before 'NEXT ROUND · STARTS IN', blinking teal dot in 'RACE PREVIEW · SIMULATED'. Countdown digits also flicker on every tick.
why: Pulsing 'live' dots on things that are not live (a replay, a preview) are a generated-dashboard cliché. SailGP's race bar countdown has no dots or animation.
fix: Keep one red live dot only when a round is actually live. Remove the others and the digit 'tick' animation.
where: src/season-calendar.html:443-446 livepulse; 89-90 .chip-dk i; 94-95 blink; 284-286 .cd .k i; 359 .rbadge i; 69-70 tick

title: Bold caps title with light-italic grey year, eyebrow and lede
what: 'WORLD CALENDAR' in 800 caps, then '2026/27' in thin italic grey, with an orange eyebrow 'PARAGLIDING · SEASON 2026/27' above (repeating the year) and a marketing lede below.
why: Heavy + light-italic contrast inside one headline is a widely generated pattern. SailGP: '2026 SEASON CALENDAR', one weight, no eyebrow, no lede.
fix: '2026/27 WORLD CALENDAR' in one weight; drop the eyebrow and the lede (or one short factual line).

title: Centred heading + lede paragraph on every section
what: CALENDAR (with two anchor buttons), THE TOUR ('Where the season races… Tap a venue…'), SEASON AT A GLANCE ('Each bar runs from the first to the last competition day…') all use the same centred 56 px heading with a grey explanatory paragraph.
why: Identical centred head + lede is the template rhythm the owner dislikes; instructional ledes ('Tap a venue') are UI narration. SailGP section titles are left or centred with no explanatory paragraph.
fix: Left-aligned headings at the content edge, no ledes; remove the 'All rounds / Season timeline' anchor buttons (the nav covers them).

title: Marketing filler copy
what: 'Paragliding racing for a new generation', 'Who will be the SRS Master for 2027?', 'Every competition on Airtribune this season. Follow the tour…', footer heading 'Explore'.
why: Rhetorical questions and slogan headlines read as generated. SailGP copy is factual ('Abu Dhabi hosts the championship-deciding Grand Final…').
fix: Factual lines: 'SRS 2027: five rounds, Slovenia to St André, World Sports Final at Gemona'; feature: '17–24 July, Gemona. Seven tasks decide the first SRS world title.' Footer heading 'Calendar'.

title: Same dates written five different ways
what: Race bar '25 Nov – 29 Nov 2026' (month repeated), hero card '25–29 NOV · PAKISTAN', strip '25 Nov – 29 Nov 2026 · 5 days', row '25–29 NOV', map '25–29 Nov', feature '17–24 JUL 2027'; strip uses leading zeros '09 JAN', other places '9'.
why: Inconsistent formatting shows assembled components. SailGP uses one style: '28 - 29 NOV 2026'.
fix: One helper: same month '25–29 Nov 2026', cross month '27 Jan – 3 Feb 2027'; no leading zeros; same case everywhere.

title: Segmented chip control with counts
what: Filters are a panel-coloured pill group 'ALL 26 · [SRS] 5 · HIKE & FLY 2 · OPEN & CUPS 19', a dropdown 'ALL REGIONS · 26' and a rounded search box, in a frosted sticky bar.
why: Count badges inside chips are a SaaS-dashboard pattern. SailGP's season switch is plain text tabs ('2026 SEASON  2027 SEASON') with an underline.
fix: Plain text tabs with orange underline for the active one, no counts; region as plain text links or a simple select without count; search as an underlined field.

title: Gantt 'bars' are numbered pills and dots
what: The timeline is a rounded panel with alternating month bands; most rounds render as tiny numbered pills; next round gets a dashed yellow ring, 'TODAY' a yellow pill; a colour legend sits below. On phone it shows only Nov–Jan and the legend wraps.
why: Pills with numbers inside, dashed rings and legends are chart-library defaults; the chart does not show anything the strip/list does not.
fix: Either remove the section or make it a typographic month grid: month columns with round city names as text, no pills, no legend, hairline for today.

title: Generated terrain map, pill chip and tinted glass time box
what: The open column shows a procedurally generated contour 'terrain' with a fake task, a pill chip '81.8 km task · 4 turnpoints', then a three-cell orange-tinted glass box 'DAY 1 LOCAL / YOUR TIME / DURATION'.
why: Noise-generated topography and pill overlays look synthetic. SailGP's open column shows a clean line silhouette of the host country with the venue dot, solid buttons, and race-day times as plain text.
fix: Replace the task map with a simple outline of the host country/region with a venue dot (data already loaded for the tour map). Times as two plain lines ('Day 1: Wed 25 Nov, 09:00 local'). No chip.

title: 'Simulated / preview' announced everywhere
what: 'Tasks and race replays are simulated' in the concept bar, 'PREVIEW' on 21 rows, 'RACE PREVIEW · SIMULATED' badge, a disclaimer paragraph in the drawer, and 'Tasks, tracks and races are simulated' in the footer.
why: Repeated disclaimers draw attention to the demo nature. (The Concept label itself must stay.)
fix: Keep the concept label; once fake tasks/podiums are removed (findings on rows and drawer) most disclaimers go. Leave a single footnote where any simulation remains.

title: Eight boxed spec cells of filler
what: A 2×4 grid of panel cells: Dates, Duration, Venue, Region ('Asia'), Coordinates ('33.00°N 72.50°E'), Local time ('UTC+5'), From previous round ('Season opener'), Next round.
why: Boxed key/value grids padded with trivia are generated-info-card style. SailGP's event page gives 'RACE DAY 1 | SATURDAY, 28 NOVEMBER / Race Times | 14:00–15:30 GST' as plain bold lines with a vertical rule.
fix: Two or three plain lines: dates with weekdays, venue + country, local start time. Drop Region, Coordinates and the boxes.

title: Pill chips and badge boxes
what: 'NEXT ROUND' and 'IN 112 DAYS' pills beside the flag, a single 'CUP' tag pill, 'RACE PREVIEW · SIMULATED' badge, and a blue-bordered rounded box 'PART OF THE SPORTS-CLASS RACING SERIES' with the logo.
why: Status chips everywhere are a component-library habit. SailGP uses text: 'EVENT 13' and the dates, no chips.
fix: Status as plain text after the dates ('Starts tomorrow'); drop the tag pill; SRS as logo + one line of text, no box.

title: Three outlined pill boxes in the header
what: Nav has an outlined 'LIVE' pill and an outlined 'FEATURED SERIES [SRS]' box with two-line micro text; the race bar has a blue frosted pill 'NEXT SRS ROUND SLOVENIA · 112 DAYS'.
why: Outlined pills crowding the header look assembled. SailGP's header is plain text links plus one solid button; the race bar carries the sponsor lock-up without a box.
fix: Nav: plain 'Live' text link; SRS logo unboxed (no 'Featured series' label). Race bar: drop the SRS pill or show the SRS mark + text without border/background.

title: Ken Burns zoom, hover zoom and a glass card over the subject
what: Hero photo slowly zooms (30 s Ken Burns); the feature photo scales on hover; the feature glass card covers the pilot's harness; buttons lift 1 px on hover; SRS cards slide 6 px.
why: Gratuitous motion is a generated-site tell. SailGP photos are static, full-bleed or cleanly rounded, and text sits beside them, not on frosted panels over them.
fix: Static photos; place feature text beside/below the image or on a plain dark band; remove translate hover effects.

title: Three italic styles mixed everywhere
what: Heavy italic (stat numbers, SRS heading, R-numbers, countdown, podium, footer headings, drawer header), light italic (hero year, strip subtitle, drawer subtitle), regular italic (event names, SRS-card subtitles, photo credits).
why: Italics as a default style rather than a decision. SailGP uses heavy italic for the race-bar event name and footer headings only; numbers and body are upright.
fix: Pick one: heavy italic for the race bar name and footer headings; everything else upright. Numbers upright with tabular figures.

title: SRS rows: photo thumbnails, blue label line, mixed row heights
what: SRS rows are 128 px with a rounded photo thumb (gradient overlay + route glyph + km), a blue tracked-caps 'SPORTS-CLASS RACING SERIES · ROUND 2 OF 5' line with logo; other rows are 72 px. The SRS logo appears about 15 times on the page (nav, race bar, hero, section, strip, feature, legend, filter chip, 5 rows, drawer, footer).
why: Mixed row heights with card thumbnails break the timing-board rhythm; logo stamped on everything dilutes it. SailGP keeps rows identical and lets one featured panel carry the sponsor lock-up.
fix: Same height for every row; SRS rows marked with the SRS mark in place of the type label and 'SRS Round 2' in the meta line; no thumbnails. Keep the big logo in the SRS block and nav only.

title: Frosted glass on about ten surfaces
what: Glass/blur on: sticky nav, filters bar, phone month rail, hero card, feature card, live-tracker card, SRS round cards, race-bar SRS pill, drawer header, strip time box, podium steps, status badges.
why: Cards may be glass, but blur on everything reads as an effect pack. SailGP's surfaces are flat solid colours.
fix: Keep glass on at most the hero/feature cards; everything else solid (nav solid #03100F, filters solid, drawer header solid).

title: Decorative rings, rounded frosted cards, red FINAL pill
what: Two huge rotated blue/red ring arcs drawn by ::before/::after cut across the background photo; rounds are rounded frosted cards that slide on hover; the final gets a red border, red numeral and a red 'FINAL' pill.
why: Decorative geometry and card-per-item are generated patterns. SailGP lists events as ruled columns/rows.
fix: Remove .srs-sec::before/::after; list the five rounds as ruled rows (hairlines, no card backgrounds, no hover slide); 'Final' as plain text after the name.

title: Card inside a card inside the hero card
what: The glass info card holds a chip, title, button, then a second bordered card (LIVE TRACKER with red dot and → arrow), then a divider and an SRS logo block: three modules in one card.
why: Nested cards are a generated-layout habit. SailGP's hero has the title and one action.
fix: If the card stays: title, dates, one orange button. Move live tracker and SRS links elsewhere.

title: Drawer header: italic tinted title, glass bar, auto focus ring
what: Header reads 'ROUND 01 / 26' in heavy italic peach on a frosted bar with an orange hairline; on open the close button shows a 2 px orange rounded focus ring (focus is set programmatically).
why: Focus ring visible to mouse users and the tinted glass bar look unfinished. SailGP's overlays use plain solid headers.
fix: Solid header, upright 'Round 1 of 26' in white; focus the drawer container (tabindex=-1) instead of the close button so no ring shows on mouse open.

title: White circle arrow buttons with drop shadow
what: Prev/next are 44 px white circles with a heavy shadow overlaid on the strip; the disabled one becomes a grey translucent disc that sits on the content.
why: Floating circle arrows are a carousel-kit default. SailGP uses a small square white tab at the strip edge.
fix: Small square or flat edge tabs, no shadow; hide (not grey out) when disabled.

title: Map labels with helper narration; route crosses a label
what: Labels read 'Glencoe, Scotland ↑ · off map, 1,800 km north-west', 'Europe · 10 rounds · Mar–Sep · close-up right', caption 'SRS route in white'; the Kruševo label is struck through by the route lines; a rectangle frames Europe on the world map.
why: Explanatory UI narration inside a graphic feels generated. Broadcast maps label places with name + date only.
fix: Labels: name + dates only. Glencoe as an inset or a plain note in the caption; nudge Kruševo label below the dot; drop 'close-up right' and the frame (or keep frame without text).

title: Text wrapping badly
what: Tour stats: continents list wraps with a dangling '·' at line end; phone SRS KPIs wrap 3 + 1 orphan; phone strip 'DAY 1 LOCAL' wraps into 4 lines; phone drawer 'RACE PREVIEW · SIMULATED' and 'RACE TIME' wrap; at 1440 'Season at a glance' lede ends with orphan 'stack.'.
why: Uncontrolled wraps signal nobody looked at the result.
fix: Mostly solved by deleting those elements (see stat/lede/spec findings); otherwise shorten text, use text-wrap:pretty, and lay KPIs as 2×2.

title: Phone filter chips and search clipped
what: At 390 the chip row is cut mid-word ('OPEN & CUP…') and the search placeholder truncates to 'Search site, count'.
why: Clipped controls look unfinished.
fix: Plain text tabs that fit (All · SRS · Hike & fly · Open), search full width on its own row with placeholder 'Search'.
